best_idea: A target's health frame shows for a fixed short hold after any real health change (damage, heal or drain); each new change restarts the hold rather than stacking, and the frame blinks while the hold runs, so a quiet enemy shows no frame.
decision_why: Keep the restart-not-stack hold and the blink as the enemy target-frame rule on the client; fix the integer floor (a living enemy shows at least 1 px) and flash by event (damage red, heal green, drain purple) instead of the owner colour. The frame reads server health and never decides a hit or a kill.
acceptance: In a three-enemy fight only enemies hit, healed or drained in the last 8 ticks show a health frame; damage flashes red and heal flashes green; a living enemy never shows an empty bar; a second hit restarts the 8-tick count; a client test asserts the frame clears 8 ticks after the last event with no new event.
